- Sell-to-buy ratio of 0.33 is weak in the first minutes, and the last 15 minutes show heavy selling (107 SOL sold vs 142 bought) with 183 sellers.

The last 15 minutes show a 49% return on 406 buyers, but net flow was only +34 SOL, with 107 SOL sold, so the rally is being absorbed by sellers. A 9% drawdown from the 30-minute high is already underway. With a 173 SOL pool, a $20 ticket faces 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs, and a bundled coin that has already run 2.7x is a classic setup for a sharp unwind that a small move cannot outpace. Skip.
